result.summary: The street environment is extremely hostile to pedestrians, lacking any dedicated sidewalks or marked crossing infrastructure. The presence of large industrial buildings with blank walls and frequent parked vehicles forces pedestrians into the roadway, creating significant safety risks.

hazards.name: Absence of Sidewalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians are forced to walk in the travel lane due to the lack of a dedicated walkway.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked trucks and cars along the roadway edge obscure visibility between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right foreground and midground

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, wide sidewalk to separate pedestrians from vehicular traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crossings to facilitate safe movement across the street.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

result.summary: The environment is highly hostile to pedestrians, lacking any dedicated walkway or safety infrastructure. Pedestrians are forced to walk in the roadway, which is further obstructed by large utility vehicles and blank industrial frontages.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: There is no paved walkway, forcing pedestrians to walk in the travel lane or on unpaved, uneven ground.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire foreground and midground along the left side of the road

hazards.name: Large Vehicle Obstruction
hazards.description: A large utility truck and trailer are parked where a sidewalk or shoulder should be, blocking sightlines and pedestrian passage.
hazards.location_in_image: Center left, occupying the roadside area

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: A long, windowless concrete wall creates a hostile environment with no 'eyes on the street' or refuge for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Background, spanning the length of the block

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, paved sidewalk with a raised curb to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians in this industrial area.

interventions.title: Parking Management
interventions.description: Implement and enforce parking regulations to prevent large utility vehicles from obstructing pedestrian paths.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by narrow sidewalks directly adjacent to travel and parking lanes without any buffer. The street is lined with blank industrial frontages and lacks marked crossings, creating a monotonous and potentially hazardous environment for walking.

hazards.name: Narrow and obstructed sidewalks
hazards.description: Utility poles are located directly in the narrow walking path on the right side, forcing pedestrians into the street or parking lane.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no visible marked crosswalks or pedestrian infrastructure for a significant distance along this industrial corridor.

hazards.name: Blank frontages
hazards.description: Long stretches of blank walls and fences reduce natural surveillance and create an isolated environment for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalks and relocate utility poles to provide a clear, accessible walking path that meets ADA standards.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with appropriate signage to provide safe crossing opportunities along the long block.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone to provide a physical buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a continuous concrete sidewalk adjacent to an industrial or warehouse building with blank frontage. While the walkway is clear of major obstructions, the lack of a buffer from the roadway and the presence of parked vehicles create a sterile and potentially hazardous environment due to limited sightlines.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles, specifically the large SUV, block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and motorists in the roadway.

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The long, windowless wall lacks passive surveillance ('eyes on the street'), which can decrease the perceived and actual safety of pedestrians.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven surfaces on the sidewalk and at the curb edge present minor tripping hazards.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Vegetation
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or planters to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic while improving the microclimate.

interventions.title: Daylighting at Intersections
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near the nearest intersection to improve sightlines for pedestrians and drivers.
